speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you're experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and have a history of easy bruising. Can you tell me if you have a personal or family history of bleeding problems, such as prolonged bleeding after minor cuts or dental work?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of bleeding into your joints or muscles, and does the bleeding typically occur after minor trauma or spontaneously? I would also like to know if you have experienced prolonged bleeding after other procedures, such as circumcision or tonsillectomy.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your family history of joint swelling and easy bruising, I suspect a clotting factor deficiency. REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Profile

speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results show a prolonged PT and PTT, which is unusual for isolated Hemophilia A or B. Could you clarify if the bleeding time was truly prolonged, as that suggests a platelet function issue rather than just a coagulation factor deficiency? I need to rule out von Willebrand disease or a combined defect.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, joint pains (except noted in family history), or significant past illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prolonged PTT and bleeding time with normal platelets, this presentation is highly suggestive of von Willebrand disease. I will request specific factor assays to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Von_Willebrand_Factor_Assay
